title: No More Tomatoes
setting: The kitchen of a small family restaurant.

characters.name: Rosa
characters.look: Rosa, a young girl with short brown hair and a yellow shirt

characters.name: Father
characters.look: Rosa's father, a man with long legs, a moustache and a tall white chef's hat

sentences.en: Rosa's father has a small restaurant in town.
sentences.zh: 罗莎的爸爸在镇上开了一家小餐馆。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa's father, a man with long legs, a moustache and a tall white chef's hat stands proudly in front of a small restaurant with tables outside.

sentences.en: Today Rosa helps him in the kitchen.
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa, a young girl with short brown hair and a yellow shirt puts on an apron next to Rosa's father, a man with long legs, a moustache and a tall white chef's hat in a restaurant kitchen.

sentences.en: Her father has long legs and a funny hat.
sentences.zh: 她爸爸腿很长，戴着一顶滑稽的帽子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa's father, a man with long legs, a moustache and a tall white chef's hat bends down under a low shelf, his tall hat tipping, and Rosa, a young girl with short brown hair and a yellow shirt laughs.

sentences.en: Rosa cuts the fourth and last tomato.
sentences.zh: 罗莎切了第四个，也是最后一个番茄。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa, a young girl with short brown hair and a yellow shirt slices a tomato on a board next to three cut tomatoes.

sentences.en: He tries the soup, but it needs more tomatoes.
sentences.zh: 他尝了尝汤，可是还需要更多番茄。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa's father, a man with long legs, a moustache and a tall white chef's hat tastes soup from a spoon and makes a face; the tomato box is empty.

sentences.en: Rosa takes a pen and writes a shopping list.
sentences.zh: 罗莎拿起一支笔，写了一张购物清单。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa, a young girl with short brown hair and a yellow shirt writes on a small piece of paper with a pen at the kitchen table.

sentences.en: They leave for the supermarket before lunch.
sentences.zh: 他们在午饭前出发去超市。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa, a young girl with short brown hair and a yellow shirt and Rosa's father, a man with long legs, a moustache and a tall white chef's hat walk out of the restaurant toward a supermarket.

sentences.en: When they come back, people wait at the window.
sentences.zh: 他们回来时，人们正在窗边等着。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa, a young girl with short brown hair and a yellow shirt and Rosa's father, a man with long legs, a moustache and a tall white chef's hat return with bags of tomatoes; hungry people look in through the restaurant window.
